title: Ayudas de matrícula para estudiantes extranjeros no residentes, que no sean nacionales de estados miembros de la Unión Europea, que cursen estudios oficiales de Grado o de Máster universitario
legacy_titles: Ayudas de matrícula para alumnos no residentes no comunitarios (navigation label used on the official unizar.es scholarships pages)
Ayudas de la Universidad de Zaragoza para alumnos no residentes no comunitarios (page heading used on academico.unizar.es)
program_type: University means-tested tuition-fee remission (exemption of the non-EU tuition differential) administered by the host university
funding_type: Tuition fee remission only (university-funded, no living allowance)
administering_authority: Universidad de Zaragoza — Students' Affairs Vice-Rectorate (Vicerrectorado con competencia en materia de estudiantes), acting through the Sección de Becas (Scholarships Section)
implementing_agency: Universidad de Zaragoza — Sección de Becas and the Comisión de selección de beceros (Scholarship Selection Commission) established under the Normativa general de becas y ayudas al estudio de la Universidad de Zaragoza
programme_action: Chapter VI of the Normativa general de becas y ayudas al estudio de la Universidad de Zaragoza (Consejo Social agreement of 12 May 2010, amended 13 February 2013, 27 February 2014, 18 May 2017 and 29 June 2021); annual call by Resolución de la Rectora (2026-2027 call: Resolution of 6 July 2026)
description: The Universidad de Zaragoza annually issues a call for tuition-fee aid aimed at non-resident foreign students who are not nationals of an EU member state and who, for duly justified economic reasons, cannot start or continue official Bachelor's (Grado) or Master's (Máster Universitario) studies because of the price set for this group of students. Under the 2026-2027 call (Resolution of 6 July 2026 of the Rectora), the aid consists of exemption from payment of the difference between the per-credit price payable by a non-resident non-EU student and the price that would have applied had that student had resident status, so that a recipient effectively pays the public price applicable to resident and EU students. Applicants must already be enrolled in an official Grado or Máster Universitario at the University of Zaragoza for the 2026-2027 academic year and must satisfy a family income test and an academic requirement, both derived from and slightly relaxed against the Spanish Ministry of Education (MEFP) general scholarship call for 2026-2027. The aid does not provide any living costs, travel, insurance or accommodation support.

programme_structure.award_types: Single award type: exemption of the per-credit tuition differential (Base 2). No classes, tiers, quotas or ranked lists are published.
programme_structure.award_types_detail: The 2026-2027 call creates no award categories. The exempted amount is not a fixed sum: it equals the per-credit price differential published annually by the Gobierno de Aragón. First-enrolment per-credit prices for Grado in 2026-2027 are: experimentality 1 — resident/EU 20.02 EUR vs non-EU 60.06 EUR; experimentality 2 — 19.83 EUR vs 59.49 EUR; experimentality 3 — 15.52 EUR vs 46.56 EUR; experimentality 4 — 13.10 EUR vs 39.30 EUR. Second and later registrations are priced at higher published rates in each case.
programme_structure.renewal_criteria: No automatic renewal. Base 17 restricts the aid to the enrolment for academic year 2026-2027, so support in later years requires a fresh application in the following annual call. Even meeting all requirements does not guarantee the award, which is subject to the annual budget (Base 5).
programme_structure.intake: One academic year per application. The 2026-2027 call ran from 8 July 2026 to 18 September 2026 (both inclusive). The University of Zaragoza has issued this call annually since at least the 2015-2016 academic year, so a 2027-2028 call is expected in early July 2027 but has not yet been published.

status_note: The 2026-2027 call was published on the University's Tablón Oficial de Anuncios on 6 July 2026 (announcement no. 20260000003812) and opened on 8 July 2026, closing on 18 September 2026, both dates inclusive. The announcement record was withdrawn from the official notice board on 6 October 2026. The call is annual (previous calls are listed for 2015-2016 through 2022-2023 on the official historical calls page), so the next edition for academic year 2027-2028 is expected around early July 2027, with a similar closing date in mid-September; this has not been published at the time of verification.
verification_type: Published official call (Resolución de la Rectora) with signed PDF annex, plus the awarding body's own informational pages

application_deadline.typical_application_window: Applications open in early July and close in mid-September of each academic year (2026-2027: 8 July to 18 September)
application_deadline.application_period: 8 July 2026 to 18 September 2026, both dates inclusive (Base 7)
application_deadline.official_rule: Base 7 of the 2026-2027 call: 'Las solicitudes se podrán presentar desde el 08 de julio de 2026 hasta el 18 de septiembre de 2026'. The call publishes the closing date but no closing hour. The SOLICIT@ electronic service is stated to be 'Abierto las 24 horas de todos los días del año', so in practice submissions were accepted until the end of 18 September 2026 in Spain. No other cut-off or time limit is published.
application_deadline.deadline_warning: This deadline has already passed. The 2026-2027 call closed on 18 September 2026 and the notice was withdrawn from the Tablón Oficial on 6 October 2026; applications can no longer be submitted for that cycle. Do not rely on this date for a 2027-2028 application — wait for the new call.

programme_duration.official_range: The award covers a single academic year (2026-2027). The underlying official Bachelor's degree (Grado) is a full multi-year degree, but the official pages reviewed for this call do not state a total ECTS credit figure or a number of years.
programme_duration.renewal_note: Base 17: 'Las ayudas previstas en la presente convocatoria alcanzan exclusivamente a la matrícula correspondiente al curso académico 2026-2027'. There is no automatic renewal; each academic year requires a new application in the newly issued call.

funding.scholarship_type: Tuition fee remission only — exemption of the difference between the non-EU/non-resident per-credit price and the resident per-credit price
funding.monthly_amount_note: No monthly stipend or allowance of any kind is published. The aid is exclusively a tuition-fee differential (Base 2).
funding.travel_amount_note: Not published in the official source. The call provides no travel or installation grant.
funding.fully_funded_note: Not a full scholarship. The award only removes the non-EU tuition differential. It does not cover living costs, accommodation, travel, insurance or the base tuition that resident/EU students also pay, and no bond or service obligation is attached.

tuition.amount: Exemption of the per-credit price differential between the non-EU/non-resident rate and the resident/EU rate (Base 2). 2026-2027 first-enrolment published rates for Grado: experimentality 1 — 60.06 EUR (non-EU) vs 20.02 EUR (resident/EU); experimentality 2 — 59.49 vs 19.83 EUR; experimentality 3 — 46.56 vs 15.52 EUR; experimentality 4 — 39.30 vs 13.10 EUR. The differential therefore ranges from roughly 26.20 to 40.04 EUR per ECTS credit depending on the degree's experimental class and the registration number.
tuition.conditions: Applies only to the enrolment (matrícula) for academic year 2026-2027 in official Grado or Máster Universitario studies at the University of Zaragoza (Base 17). Recipients pay the same enrolment price as resident and EU students, provisionally, while the decision is pending.

visa_support.note: Not published in official source. Applicants must independently hold legal stay in Spain (Base 3).

family_allowance.note: No family allowance is published. Family size is used only to set the family income threshold (Umbral 1) that determines eligibility.

accommodation_support.note: Not published in official source. Applicants must supply proof of ownership or rental of the dwelling they will occupy (Base 6d) but receive no accommodation grant.

bond.note: No bond, service obligation or return-to-country requirement. Base 16 states these aids have a complementary character and are incompatible with other aid granted for the same purpose and same concepts.

total_estimated_value.note: No total value is published and none is computed here. The award is not a fixed sum: it is the per-credit price differential set each year by the Gobierno de Aragón, so its value depends on the degree's experimental class, the number of credits enrolled and the registration number. Presenting a single total would misrepresent the award.

coverage: Exemption of the difference between the per-credit tuition price payable by a non-resident non-EU student and the price that would have applied with resident status, for official Grado or Máster Universitario studies at the University of Zaragoza (Base 2)
Provisional payment of the enrolment at the same price as resident and EU students while the application is being decided (Disposición adicional única)
coverage_limitations: Tuition differential only. The award provides no living allowance, travel, insurance, installation, accommodation or book support; none is published in the official call or pages.

The benefit is not a fixed amount. It equals the per-credit price differential set annually by the Gobierno de Aragón, so the value differs by degree experimental class, registration number and credits enrolled.
Coverage is limited to the enrolment for academic year 2026-2027 (Base 17); later years require a new application.
Meeting all requirements does not guarantee the award, which is subject to that year's budget (Base 5).
The number of awards is not published; no allocation, quota or reserve for any nationality exists.
The same call covers both Bachelor's (Grado) and Master's (Máster Universitario) studies; this record documents the Bachelor's application and notes the Master's coverage here.
eligible_applicants: Non-resident foreign nationals who are not nationals of an EU member state (Base 3). After Brexit, UK nationals are treated as non-EU unless they prove resident status with a valid TIE residence permit.
Students in a situation of legal stay in Spain ('estancia legal') (Base 3)
Students already enrolled (matriculados) in an official Grado or Máster Universitario at the Universidad de Zaragoza for academic year 2026-2027 (Base 3)
Students whose family income does not exceed the MEFP 2026-2027 family income threshold for the fixed amount linked to income (Threshold 1 / Umbral 1)

Students who meet the academic requirements of the MEFP 2026-2027 general scholarship call for public-price tuition aid, relaxed by 0.5 grade points and 15 percentage points of credits passed (Base 4)
final_year_condition: Not applicable in the conventional sense. This is an award for students already enrolled, not for incoming applicants: Base 3 requires the applicant to be matriculado in an official Grado or Máster Universitario at the Universidad de Zaragoza for academic year 2026-2027. A student still completing secondary school is therefore not eligible until they have actually enrolled at the university.
equivalent_degree_note: Where the previous studies that gave access to the Grado or Máster were taken or obtained in foreign university systems, applicants must supply the homologation credential (credencial de homologación) including the average grade, or alternatively the 'Declaración de equivalencia de nota media de estudios universitarios realizados en centros extranjeros' (Base 6e). The period of income evidence is calendar year 2025.

eligibility.citizenship: Non-resident foreign nationals who are not nationals of an EU member state (Base 3). Open to all other nationalities worldwide without nationality quotas.
eligibility.residence_requirement: The applicant must be in a situation of legal stay in Spain at the time of application (Base 3). Residency for enrolment-price purposes is a different status: only a valid TIE showing a RESIDENCIA permit, not an ESTANCIA/STUDIES permit, proves resident status.
eligibility.secondary_school_requirement: Not stated in this call. Eligibility rests on being enrolled in an official Grado or Máster Universitario at the Universidad de Zaragoza for 2026-2027; the admission requirements to the degree itself are set separately by the university's admission rules.
eligibility.academic_requirements: The same academic requirements as the MEFP general scholarship call 2026-2027 for the public-price tuition aid, with two relaxations: the minimum required grade is reduced by 0.5 points, and the required percentage of credits passed relative to credits enrolled is reduced by 15 percentage points (Base 4). Where requirements are equally met, the academic record prevails.
eligibility.previous_scholarship_restriction: These aids are complementary and are incompatible with aid granted by any other public or private body for the same purpose and same concepts (Base 16). Only one aid may be received even if several studies are taken simultaneously (Base 15).
eligibility.enrolment_status_requirement: The applicant must already be enrolled (matriculado) in an official Grado or Máster Universitario at the Universidad de Zaragoza for academic year 2026-2027 (Base 3). Part-time status is determined by the MEFP call for each type of study.

academic_requirements.percentage_note: No percentage is published by the university. The call applies the MEFP 2026-2027 general scholarship requirements for the public-price tuition aid and reduces the required percentage of credits passed (relative to credits enrolled) by 15 percentage points (Base 4). The underlying MEFP figure differs between Grado and Máster and is not reproduced on the unizar.es pages reviewed.
academic_requirements.programme_specific_requirements: Requirements are set by study level, following the MEFP general call for each type of study (grado or máster universitario). Part-time status is likewise determined annually by the MEFP call (Base 4).
selection_factors_may_include: Family income level (Umbral 1 threshold of the MEFP 2026-2027 call) (Base 4)
Academic record, used as tie-breaker where requirements are equally met (Base 4)
Degree of economic difficulty, with the commission attending first to students with lower economic capacity (Base 5)
Single-parent families and other similar situations valued by the commission (Base 5)
academic_requirements.holistic_selection_note: Selection is essentially a means test with an academic tie-breaker rather than a holistic merit competition. Leadership, extracurricular achievement, community service and portfolio play no published role.

english_requirement.test_score_note: The official call for this aid sets no language test requirement and publishes no test scores. Any language requirement applies to admission to the degree programme, not to this award.

language_of_instruction.bilingual_programmes: The aid call itself sets no language requirement. The official 2026-2027 public-price table for Grado published on unizar.es includes at least one degree listed with an English title ('Empresa Internacional / Bachelor in International Business'), so the language of instruction should be checked per degree. No official page reviewed states the language of instruction of each Grado.
language_of_instruction.language_note: This award is granted on tuition, income and enrolment grounds; language plays no part in it. Language of instruction is a property of the individual Grado programme, not of this call.

application_method.application_route: Direct application by the student to the Universidad de Zaragoza, preferably through the SOLICIT@ service of the university's Sede Electrónica (sede.unizar.es/solicita) using a digital electronic certificate or a valid coordinated identification (NIP and administrative password); exceptionally through the University's general registry, its auxiliary registries, or any procedure under Ley 39/2015.
application_steps: Confirm you are a non-resident foreign student who is not an EU national, with legal stay in Spain, and are enrolled in an official Grado or Máster Universitario at the Universidad de Zaragoza for 2026-2027.
Download the official application form for the current call from academico.unizar.es (Becas > Ayudas de matrícula para alumnos no residentes no comunitarios > Cómo y cuándo presentar la solicitud).
Complete the form, including an e-mail address, then download, print and sign it. Applications without the official form are not accepted for processing.

Assemble the supporting documents listed in Base 6 (legal stay document, ID/passport copies of all family-unit members, 2025 income documents with IRPF certificate where applicable, housing ownership or rental proof, and the homologation credential or average-grade equivalence declaration where the access studies were foreign).
Submit via SOLICIT@ at sede.unizar.es/solicita (open 24 hours a day, every day of the year), or exceptionally via the University's registry.
At enrolment, give the secretariat of the teaching centre the receipt proving the application was lodged in time and in the prescribed form, so the provisional resident-level price can be applied.
Await the proposed resolution on the Tablón Oficial (within three months of the end of the application period), file any allegations within ten working days, and then check for the final resolution.
application_method.application_fee: No application fee is mentioned in the official call or on the official pages.
application_method.multiple_applications_allowed: Only one aid may be received even if several studies are taken simultaneously (Base 15). The call does not state whether more than one application may be lodged.

E-mail address stated on the application form (used for all communications by the selection commission)

Photocopy of the identity document or passport of every member of the family unit
Photocopy of the 2025 income of family-unit members with computable income; if any member earns income in Spain, the Certificado Resumen del IRPF for 2025
Photocopy of the document proving ownership or rental of the dwelling the applicant will occupy during the academic year

Where the studies that gave access to the Grado or Máster were taken or obtained in foreign university systems, the homologation credential including the average grade, or alternatively the 'Declaración de equivalencia de nota media de estudios universitarios realizados en centros extranjeros'
official_application_documents.document_language: Documents must be accompanied, where applicable, by the corresponding sworn translation into Spanish, unless they are already in English (Base 6).
official_application_documents.document_format: The application form must be downloaded, printed, signed and submitted together with photocopies of the supporting documents; lodgement is electronic via SOLICIT@ or, exceptionally, on paper through a university registry.
official_application_documents.transcript_requirement: An official average-grade credential is required only where the access studies to the Grado or Máster were taken in a foreign university system: the homologation credential including the nota media, or the declaración de equivalencia de nota media (Base 6e).

identity_documents.requirement: Photocopy; must cover every member of the family unit (Base 6b)

identity_documents.item: Document proving legal stay in Spain (estancia or residencia for studies)
identity_documents.requirement: Original or copy; if expired, evidence that renewal has been started (Base 6a)

academic_documents.item: Proof of enrolment (matrícula) in official Grado or Máster Universitario at the Universidad de Zaragoza for 2026-2027
academic_documents.requirement: Implicit in Base 3; applicants must be matriculados in the current academic year

academic_documents.item: Homologation credential with average grade, or Declaración de equivalencia de nota media
academic_documents.requirement: Only where the access studies to the Grado or Máster were taken or obtained in foreign university systems (Base 6e)

language_documents.requirement: Required for any document not in English (Base 6)

application_essays.item: Motivation letter, personal statement or essay
application_essays.requirement: Not requested by this call; the application is form-based plus documentary evidence

Must be stated on the form (Base 6, Base 10)

selection_process.decision_maker: Comisión de selección de beceros of the Universidad de Zaragoza (Base 8), chaired by the Vicerrector with competence in student matters, with the Vicegerente Académica as deputy chair, one professor designated by the Rectora, two student representatives, one Consejo Social representative, and the administrative head of the Sección de Becas as secretary.
selection_process.selection_type: Means-tested administrative selection; competitive only insofar as awards are limited by the annual budget (Base 5)
possible_stages: Lodgement of the application via SOLICIT@ (or exceptionally a university registry)
Administrative verification of requirements and documentation by the Sección de Becas, with a remediation request where documents are missing (Base 9)
Valuation by the Comisión de selección de beceros, attending first to students with lower economic capacity (Base 5)
Publication of the proposed resolution on the Tablón Oficial de la Universidad de Zaragoza; ten working days for allegations (Base 11)
Final resolution and publication on the Tablón Oficial (Base 12)
Possible appeal to the Rectora under articles 121 et seq. of Ley 39/2015 (Base 13)
selection_process.official_universal_weighting: No numeric weighting is published. Base 4 states that where requirements are equally met the academic record prevails; Base 5 states that the commission attends to students with lower economic capacity, with special consideration for single-parent families and other similar situations.
selection_process.weighting_note: The published rules give economic need the operative priority and treat the academic record only as a tie-breaker. There is no points system, rubric or percentage split to record.
selection_process.results_timing: The proposed resolution must be published within three months of the end of the last application period (Base 11), i.e. by about 18 December 2026 for the 2026-2027 call. No calendar date is published for the final resolution.
selection_process.scholarship_rank_note: No ranking, waiting list, allocation table or number of awards is published. Base 5 states that meeting the conditions does not necessarily imply the award, since awards are subject to the year's budget.

selection_criteria.academic_excellence: Tie-breaker only: where requirements are equally met, the academic record prevails (Base 4). No grades, scores or academic thresholds are published as an award criterion for this call.
selection_criteria.additional_factors: The commission attends to students with lower economic capacity and gives special consideration to single-parent families and other similar situations it chooses to value (Base 5).

degree_outcome.awarded_qualification: None awarded by this call. The aid is a reduction of the enrolment price for an official Bachelor's degree (Grado) or official Master's degree (Máster Universitario) of the Universidad de Zaragoza.
degree_outcome.typical_programme_length: The award covers one academic year. The underlying official Bachelor's degree is a full degree programme, but the official pages reviewed for this call do not state a total ECTS credit figure.
degree_outcome.degree_note: The same call covers both Grado and Máster Universitario studies. This record documents the Bachelor's (Grado) application; Master's applicants should note that the MEFP academic and economic thresholds applied differ by study level.
degree_outcome.credit_transfer: Not addressed by this call. Recognition and transfer of credits is handled separately under the University of Zaragoza's own reconocimiento y transferencia de créditos procedure.

student_rights_and_cost_protection.tuition_fee_for_recipients: Recipients are exempted from the difference between the non-EU/non-resident per-credit price and the resident per-credit price (Base 2), so they pay at the public price applicable to resident and EU students.
student_rights_and_cost_protection.application_fee_for_recipients: No application fee is published in the official call.
student_rights_and_cost_protection.student_agreement: Not published in the official source. The call does not establish a student agreement, covenant or contract of any kind.
student_rights_and_cost_protection.common_services: The call exempts only the credit-price differential and says nothing about other university fees, services or student protections. Applicants may provisionally pay the resident-level price while the decision is pending, by presenting proof of application to the secretariat of their teaching centre.
student_rights_and_cost_protection.bond_breach_consequence: Not applicable — no bond or service obligation is imposed. The only adverse consequence published concerns denial: if the aid is finally denied, the applicant must regularise the enrolment by paying the amount due, and non-payment leads to annulment of the enrolment under current legislation (Disposición adicional única).

application_readiness_checklist: Confirm non-EU nationality and non-resident status, and that you hold legal stay in Spain
Confirm you are already enrolled in an official Grado or Máster Universitario at the Universidad de Zaragoza for the target academic year
Check your family income against the published Umbral 1 thresholds for your family size
Obtain the homologation credential or average-grade equivalence declaration if your access studies were foreign
Gather 2025 income evidence for all family-unit members, including the IRPF certificate where applicable
Gather housing ownership or rental evidence
Obtain a digital certificate or NIP and administrative password to use SOLICIT@
Give the secretariat of your teaching centre the application receipt at enrolment to obtain the provisional resident-level price
programme_comparison_fields: Award type (tuition differential vs full tuition vs stipend)
Published per-credit price for non-EU students versus resident/EU students in the relevant year
Whether the applicant must already be enrolled
Family income threshold and family-size bands
Academic requirement and any relaxation against the national scheme
Whether the award is renewable (no — annual re-application)
Compatibility with other scholarships or grants
practical_application_data.motivation_letter_strategy: No motivation letter is requested or accepted. The application is documentary: invest effort in a complete, internally consistent income file and in obtaining the homologation or average-grade equivalence credential, since incomplete documentation is the main ground for rejection. Use the e-mail field carefully because the selection commission communicates every step by e-mail.
profile_fit_labels: Non-EU national already enrolled at the University of Zaragoza
Enrolled full-time or part-time in an official Grado
Needs tuition relief rather than living costs
Has, or can obtain, legal stay in Spain
common_mistakes: Applying before being enrolled: the call requires the applicant to be matriculado for the current academic year, so an applicant who has not yet enrolled is not eligible
Assuming the award covers living costs, accommodation or travel — it exempts only the tuition differential
Assuming the award is guaranteed once requirements are met — awards are subject to the annual budget
Submitting without the official form, which is rejected for processing
Forgetting the sworn translation of documents not in English
Expecting automatic renewal in later years; each academic year needs a fresh application
Assuming a UK passport implies EU treatment — after Brexit UK nationals pay the non-EU price unless they hold a valid residence permit
Missing the mid-September closing date because the e-office is open 24/7 and appears always available

risk_flags.impact: Applicants who have not yet enrolled in an official Grado or Máster Universitario at the Universidad de Zaragoza for the academic year are ineligible, so this award cannot be used to secure or pre-fund a place
risk_flags.mitigation: Treat it as a cost-reduction award for students already admitted and enrolled, not as an entry scholarship. Secure admission and enrolment first, then apply when the call opens.

risk_flags.impact: Base 5 states that meeting the requirements does not necessarily imply the award and that awards depend on the year's budget; the number of awards is not published
risk_flags.mitigation: Budget for the full non-EU tuition fee in parallel and have a funding fallback; do not treat the tuition differential as already secured.

risk_flags.risk: Tuition differential only, no living support
risk_flags.impact: The award provides no stipend, travel, insurance, installation, accommodation or book support, so the cost of studying is far higher than the award amount
risk_flags.mitigation: Model the full cost of living separately and identify other funding; the aid only brings tuition down to the resident/EU level.

risk_flags.impact: If the aid is denied after the applicant paid the provisional resident-level price, they must regularise the enrolment by paying the balance; non-payment leads to annulment of the enrolment
risk_flags.mitigation: Present the application receipt to the teaching centre secretariat at enrolment to obtain the provisional price, and keep funds available to cover the higher fee in case of denial.

risk_flags.impact: Base 16 makes the aid incompatible with other public or private aid granted for the same purpose and the same concepts, and Base 15 allows only one aid even across simultaneous studies
risk_flags.mitigation: Check overlap with any Spanish ministry (MEFP) grant or other scholarship before accepting; a conflict can require repayment of one of the awards.

risk_flags.risk: Income and academic thresholds are externally defined and change annually
risk_flags.impact: Both the income thresholds and the academic requirements are those of the MEFP general scholarship call for the same year, so what qualified in one year may not qualify in the next; the only relaxations are 0.5 grade points and 15 percentage points of credits
risk_flags.mitigation: Re-read the new annual call and the accompanying MEFP call rather than reusing last year's assessment; record the year you checked.

risk_flags.risk: Annual cycle with a hard deadline
risk_flags.impact: The call closes on a fixed date in mid-September and the notice is withdrawn from the official board shortly after; a missed window means waiting a full academic year
risk_flags.mitigation: Monitor the official page and the Tablón Oficial from early July; the deadline is 18 September for the 2026-2027 cycle and is expected to be similar for the next cycle.

application_status_workflow: Valuation by the Comisión de selección de beceros (Base 5)
Proposed resolution published on the Tablón Oficial (Base 11)
Allegations open for ten working days
Final resolution published on the Tablón Oficial (Base 12)

best_fit: Non-EU nationals who are already admitted and enrolled in an official Bachelor's degree (Grado) at the Universidad de Zaragoza, hold legal stay in Spain, have a low or middle family income, and need their tuition brought down from the non-EU rate to the resident/EU rate. database_notes: No substitution was required. The assigned target — the Universidad de Zaragoza call for non-EU, non-resident students — exists, is current for the 2026-2027 academic year, and does not appear on the do-not-duplicate list in research/bachelor/RESEARCH_PROTOCOL.md. The file was written to the assigned slot 10-spain-zaragoza-international.json as instructed.

Date reference: the schema contract (SCHEMA_CONTRACT.md) states 'Today is 2026-10-03'. This record was actually researched and verified on 2026-10-10, which is corroborated both by the system clock and by the official 'Fecha y hora oficiales' clock on sede.unizar.es (which read 10/10/2026 at the time of checking). last_verified_date, _verification_timestamp, logo_verified_at and image_verified_at use the real verification date. The 2026-2027 deadline (18 September 2026) had already passed under either date, so the CLOSED status and the next-cycle expectations are unaffected.

The official 2026-2027 notice (Tablón Oficial de Anuncios no. 20260000003812) carries 'Fecha Retirada: 06-10-2026', i.e. it was withdrawn from the official notice board on 6 October 2026 after the application period closed. The record and the signed PDF remain reachable at the URL cited.

No official acronym exists for this award. short_title is a deliberate truncation of the official title; the University of Zaragoza's own navigation label for the award is 'Ayudas de matrícula para alumnos no residentes no comunitarios', which is recorded in legacy_titles.
The official title used in each annual call appends 'durante el curso académico YYYY-YYYY'. The year-free form of the official name is used here so that the record does not churn each cycle.

Award value: the call publishes no monetary amount and none has been computed. The benefit is the per-credit price differential fixed annually by the Gobierno de Aragón. The 2026-2027 first-enrolment per-credit figures reproduced in this record (non-EU 60.06 / 59.49 / 46.56 / 39.30 EUR versus resident-EU 20.02 / 19.83 / 15.52 / 13.10 EUR for experimental classes 1 to 4) come from the official public-price table for Grado published on academico.unizar.es under the Decreto del Gobierno de Aragón of 24 June 2026 (BOA of 29 June 2026). Second, third and later registrations are priced at higher published rates and are not reproduced here.

Number of awards is not published. Base 5 states only that awards are subject to the year's budget and that the commission attends first to students with lower economic capacity, with special consideration for single-parent families.

Deadline hour: the call gives the closing date but no hour. Because SOLICIT@ is stated to be open 24 hours a day, every day of the year, the practical cut-off was the end of 18 September 2026 in Spain (Europe/Madrid, CEST). The timezone field reflects this inference and is not quoted from the call.

The family income thresholds reproduced here are the 'UMBRAL 1' values published on the official requirements page (1 member: 8,843.00 EUR; 2: 13,264.00; 3: 17,685.00; 4: 22,107.00; 5: 25,644.00; 6: 29,181.00; 7: 32,718.00; 8: 36,255.00). These are the thresholds for the MEFP fixed amount linked to income for 2026-2027 as set out by the university; the full MEFP threshold table is not reproduced.

The academic requirement is not universal and no numeric threshold is published on unizar.es: Base 4 imports the MEFP 2026-2027 general scholarship requirements for the public-price tuition aid and relaxes them by 0.5 grade points and 15 percentage points of credits passed. The underlying MEFP figures differ between Grado and Máster and are recorded as unverified rather than estimated.

Document language rule: the signed convocatoria PDF (Base 6) requires a 'traducción jurada al castellano' (sworn translation into Spanish), except for documents already in English. The informational HTML page states the same rule without the word 'jurada'; the PDF wording was preferred as the authoritative text.

Both Bachelor's (Grado) and Master's (Máster Universitario) students may apply to the same call. This record is filed as a bachelor's award per the schema contract's rule for awards covering both levels, and the Master's coverage is flagged in funding_breakdown, coverage_limitations and degree_outcome.

Critical scope caveat recorded as a top risk: the award is not an entry scholarship. Base 3 requires the applicant to be already enrolled (matriculado) in an official Grado or Máster Universitario at the Universidad de Zaragoza for the 2026-2027 academic year, so it cannot fund or secure a place before enrolment.

The Universidad de Zaragoza runs a separate annual merit call, 'Becas a la Excelencia de la Universidad de Zaragoza' (2026-2027 window: 9 July to 18 September 2026, sede.unizar.es id 76638), which is distinct from this tuition aid and is not the subject of this record. Applicants may wish to check it separately.
The English-language URL of the award page (academico.unizar.es/en/becas/...) serves the same Spanish-language content; no separate English text exists for this award.

Total ECTS credits and the number of years of the official Grado are not stated on the official pages reviewed, so programme_duration fields are left null and the annual character of the award is documented instead.

Language of instruction is not addressed by the call. The official 2026-2027 Grado price table lists at least one degree with an English title ('Empresa Internacional / Bachelor in International Business'), but no official page reviewed states the language of each degree, so possible_languages is limited to Spanish with an explanatory note.

An official SVG wordmark is also available at https://www.unizar.es/themes/custom/unizar_unizar/img/unizar_es.svg. No third-party logo source was used.
